column2: The telescope recorded an anomalous signal that matched no known star.
column3: 望遠鏡記錄到一個與任何已知恆星都不符的異常訊號。
column5: 一群人整齊穿制服，只有一個人穿泳衣，一眼就看出反常

column2: His aberrant behavior at the meeting alarmed colleagues who knew him as calm.
column3: 他在會議上的反常舉動，讓一向認識他沉穩一面的同事大感不安。
column5: ab 離開 + err 走錯路 → 走離正軌的

column2: Snowfall in July is atypical for this region, so farmers were caught off guard.
column3: 七月下雪在這個地區並不典型，所以農夫們措手不及。
column5: a 不 + typical 典型 → 不是典型的

column2: The quiet, modern furniture was congruous with the architect's minimalist vision of the house.
column3: 簡約的現代家具與建築師對這棟房子的極簡構想十分相稱。
column4: congruous with the style (與風格相稱)
column5: con 一起 + gru 吻合：兩塊拼圖剛好卡在一起

column2: A neon sign looked incongruous on the walls of the centuries-old monastery.
column3: 霓虹招牌掛在有數百年歷史的修道院牆上，顯得格格不入。
column4: look incongruous together (放在一起不搭調)
column5: in 不 + congruous 吻合：拼圖拼不上，穿西裝配拖鞋

column2: Smartphones have become ubiquitous, appearing in nearly every classroom, café, and bus.
column3: 智慧型手機已無處不在，幾乎每間教室、咖啡館和公車上都看得到。
column5: ubi 是拉丁文「哪裡」→ 哪裡都有它

column2: Fear was omnipresent in the besieged city, felt in every street and doorway.
column3: 在被圍困的城市裡，恐懼無所不在，每條街、每道門口都感受得到。
column5: omni 全部 + present 在場 → 全部地方都在

column2: A pervasive smell of smoke clung to the village for days after the fire.
column3: 火災過後好幾天，煙味一直瀰漫在整個村莊裡。
column5: per 穿過 + vade 走 → 穿過每個縫隙到處滲透

column2: Corruption became rampant once the inspectors stopped visiting the port.
column3: 自從稽查員不再造訪港口，貪腐便猖獗起來。
column5: 野草沿著 ramp 斜坡一路亂爬，擋也擋不住

column2: Mistakes were rife in the first draft, with errors on nearly every page.
column3: 初稿裡錯誤比比皆是，幾乎每一頁都有。
column5: rife 長得像 life：生活裡到處都是壞消息

column2: Sporadic showers fell across the plains, leaving most fields dry.
column3: 平原上零星地下了幾場陣雨，大部分田地仍然乾燥。
column5: spore 孢子隨風四處落下，這裡一顆、那裡一顆

column2: Intermittent rain kept starting and stopping all afternoon, spoiling our picnic.
column3: 整個下午雨下下停停，毀了我們的野餐。
column5: inter 之間 + mit 送出 → 每隔一陣子才送來一次

column2: After a fitful night of sleep, she woke before the alarm, still exhausted.
column3: 睡得斷斷續續的一夜後，她在鬧鐘響前就醒了，依然疲憊。
column5: fit 是一陣一陣發作；睡一陣、醒一陣

column2: The company launched its product on an auspicious day, with sales exceeding every forecast.
column3: 公司在吉日推出產品，銷售量超過所有預測。
column5: 古羅馬人看鳥飛的方向占卜，鳥往好方向飛就吉利

column2: Calm seas and steady winds made it a propitious moment to set sail.
column3: 風平浪靜、風向穩定，正是啟航的好時機。
column5: 想像順風推著船前進，一切剛好適合出發

column2: The season opened on an inauspicious note when the star player was injured in the first minute.
column3: 球季開局不太吉利，王牌球員第一分鐘就受了傷。
column5: in 不 + auspicious 吉利：開頭就倒楣

column2: Dark, ominous clouds gathered over the stadium, and the crowd began to leave.
column3: 烏黑不祥的雲層聚集在球場上空，觀眾開始離場。
column5: omen 是預兆，ominous 就是帶著壞預兆的

column2: The minister's portentous tone made a routine announcement sound like a historic warning.
column3: 部長故作嚴重的語氣，讓一則例行公告聽起來像歷史性的警告。
column5: portent 是預兆；說話像要宣布大事，其實很自命不凡
column8: 凶兆；徵兆；嚴重的；自命不凡的

column2: A sinister figure watched from the doorway, and the children felt uneasy.
column3: 一個陰森的身影從門口注視著，孩子們感到不安。
column5: sinister 拉丁文原指「左邊」，古人覺得左邊不吉利

column2: The mayor's plan remained nebulous, with no dates, budgets, or named partners.
column3: 市長的計畫仍然模糊不清，沒有日期、預算，也沒有指名的夥伴。
column5: nebula 是星雲，像一團霧蒙蒙的雲，看不清楚
column8: 星雲狀；模糊不清；朦朧的

column2: The amorphous blob of clay slowly took shape under the sculptor's hands.
column3: 那團沒有固定形狀的黏土，在雕塑家手中慢慢成形。
column5: a 無 + morph 形狀 → 沒有形狀，像一團史萊姆

column2: She gave a vague answer, so nobody knew whether she would join the trip.
column3: 她的回答含糊，所以沒人知道她到底會不會參加旅行。
column5: 像隔著大霧看人影，輪廓有但看不清楚

column2: The senator gave an equivocal reply, neither supporting nor opposing the bill.
column3: 參議員的回覆模稜兩可，既沒支持也沒反對那項法案。
column5: equi 相等 + voc 聲音 → 兩種說法一樣大聲，聽不出立場

column2: I feel ambivalent about moving abroad; I long for adventure but dread leaving my family.
column3: 我對搬到國外感到矛盾：渴望冒險，卻又害怕離開家人。
column4: ambivalent about change (對改變感到矛盾)
column5: ambi 兩邊 + val 力量 → 兩邊都在拉扯你

column2: The study offered unequivocal evidence that the drug lowered blood pressure.
column3: 這項研究提供了毫不含糊的證據，證明該藥能降低血壓。
column5: un 不 + equivocal 模稜兩可 → 立場一聽就懂

column2: He gave the contract only a perfunctory glance before signing, missing the hidden fee.
column3: 他簽約前只敷衍地瞥了合約一眼，結果漏看了隱藏費用。
column5: per 通過 + function 功能：只是走過場把事做完

column2: A cursory inspection of the bridge failed to reveal the cracks beneath the paint.
column3: 對橋梁草草檢查一遍，沒發現油漆底下的裂縫。
column5: cur 是跑：邊跑邊看，只看到大概

column2: Their desultory chat jumped from football to politics to recipes with no clear thread.
column3: 他們漫無章法的閒聊從足球跳到政治再跳到食譜，毫無主線。
column5: 古羅馬特技騎士在馬背上跳來跳去，沒有固定方向

column2: His apology felt superficial, a few polite words with no real regret.
column3: 他的道歉顯得很膚淺，只是幾句客套話，毫無真正的悔意。
column5: super 上面 + fic 面 → 只停在表面，沒有深入

column2: The auditors conducted an exhaustive review, checking every invoice from the past decade.
column3: 審計人員做了徹底的查核，檢查過去十年的每一張發票。
column5: exhaust 是把水抽乾，一滴不剩，所以是徹底無遺

column2: The museum's comprehensive guide covers every period, from ancient pottery to modern sculpture.
column3: 博物館的全面導覽涵蓋每個時期，從古代陶器到現代雕塑。
column5: com 一起 + prehend 抓住 → 全部一把抓進來

column2: Her meticulousness showed in the lab notebook, where every measurement was dated and double-checked.
column3: 她的一絲不苟顯現在實驗筆記上，每個測量值都標了日期並複查過。
column4: meticulousness in record-keeping (記錄時的一絲不苟)
column5: 每個細節都要打勾 tick，打到手軟也不放過

column2: The magazine ad promised a miracle nostrum that would cure every ailment in a week.
column3: 雜誌廣告承諾有一種神奇祕方，一週內能治好所有病痛。
column4: sell a nostrum (兜售江湖偏方)
column5: 拉丁文 noster 是「我們的」→ 自家獨門祕方，但沒人驗證
column8: 江湖秘方；未經驗證的偏方

column2: Medieval alchemists searched for an elixir that would let people live forever.
column3: 中世紀的煉金術士尋找能讓人永生的長生不老藥。
column5: elixir 唸起來像「一力使」：喝了一力使你長壽

column2: The best remedy for a sore throat is rest, warm tea, and plenty of water.
column3: 治療喉嚨痛最好的方法是休息、喝熱茶和大量喝水。
column4: a remedy for pain (緩解疼痛的藥方)
column5: re 再 + med 醫 → 再醫好一次的辦法

column2: Chronic back pain was an affliction she had borne quietly for twenty years.
column3: 慢性背痛是她默默承受了二十年的折磨。
column4: suffer from an affliction (受疾患折磨)
column5: af 向 + flict 打擊 → 命運朝你打過來的一拳

column2: The town's chief malady was neglect, visible in its crumbling roads and shuttered clinics.
column3: 這個城鎮最大的弊病是長期忽視，從破敗的道路和關閉的診所就看得出來。
column5: mal 壞 + 古法語 aise 狀態 → 壞掉的狀態，也就是病

column2: Malaria remains a scourge in many tropical regions, striking children hardest.
column3: 瘧疾在許多熱帶地區仍是一大禍害，兒童受害最深。
column4: the scourge of poverty (貧窮的禍害)
column5: scourge 原指長鞭，鞭子抽下來就是苦難

column2: Weeds are the bane of every gardener, returning each spring no matter what.
column3: 雜草是每位園丁的禍根，不管怎麼處理，每年春天都會回來。
column4: the bane of my life (我生活中的剋星)
column5: bane 像 bad + pain，讓園丁又頭痛又心痛的東西

column2: The new bus line was a boon to students who once walked an hour to school.
column3: 新的公車路線對原本得走一小時上學的學生是一大恩惠。
column4: a boon to farmers (對農民的恩惠)
column5: boon 聽起來像「幫」：及時幫你一把的好事
